introduction: FirstLink’s 211 service helps North Dakota residents locate community assistance. The telephone service operates around the clock.
description: FirstLink’s 211 service helps North Dakota residents locate community assistance. The telephone service operates around the clock.

sections.who: Anyone can ask for information. Each referred organization sets its own service area and eligibility rules.
sections.get: Specialists identify resources for needs such as food, housing and utility help.
sections.docs:
• Your town or ZIP code.
  • The problem and any urgent date.
  • A place to save provider contact details.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211

    Use FirstLink for current resource-directory and contact options.

  2. Explain what is needed

    Mention your location, urgency and organizations already contacted.

  3. Contact the referral

    Ask the provider about openings, eligibility and documents before travelling.
sections.after: If a referral cannot help, contact FirstLink again with the result and ask for alternatives.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using FirstLink resource service. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: FirstLink provides referrals; the receiving program decides whether assistance is available.
Can I call after office hours?
FirstLink also provides crisis support, but its 211 resource service and 988 crisis route serve different needs.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
